POSE 1 (Top Left): ISSUE. Limbs appear disconnected or floating; spine alignment is unclear.
POSE 2 (Top Middle): OK. Balanced seated crouch; limbs and spine follow a natural curve.
POSE 3 (Top Right): ISSUE. Balance is off-center; right leg placement looks unstable.
POSE 4 (Bottom Left): ISSUE. Severe spinal distortion/twist; limb proportions look stretched.
POSE 5 (Bottom Middle): OK. Standard balanced sitting pose; spine is straight and limbs are symmetrical.
POSE 6 (Bottom Right): ISSUE. Asymmetrical leg positioning creates poor balance; arms are awkwardly raised.
